I’ll inspect the fresh workflow result and every screenshot, then fix any remaining failure before deployment. I’m using the SASE memory, repository, bead, artifact, monitor, and finalizer skills.


The new run passed 129 UI checks, including palette routing, native Vim behavior, a guarded status save, and Undo. It stopped after saving the year: the card stayed on that field instead of advancing on Tab. I’m checking whether that is a product defect or an incorrect test expectation.


The Tab failure is in the product: the save path captures the requested direction, then drops it before handling the result. The screenshots confirm a successful save with focus still on Year. Both full test suites otherwise show only known timing failures; I’m adding regression coverage before repairing Tab.


Regression tests reproduced the dropped Tab direction and a related choice-field bug that advanced twice. I’ve repaired both paths and inspected all 16 screenshots. The build and focused checks are running; full verification still needs to prove the remaining typed saves and refusal cases.


The completed build passes all 133 focused tests, including forward and backward Tab with both ready and pending previews, choice advancement, cancellation, and refusal. I’m publishing the reports and 16 inspected screenshots, then staging fresh full verification. Deployment remains pending that result.


The evidence now separates what passed from what remains open: status save and Undo are proven; the year write succeeded, but Tab navigation failed. The repaired source is unchanged since the 133-test pass. I’m finishing publication of the logs and screenshots before the rerun.


The main report, writer trace, gate logs, and repair diff are published. The screenshot set is still being registered. The phase will remain open until the fresh run proves all typed saves and refusals, followed by deployment and startup smoke.


A final review found one cancellation edge in the repair: pressing Escape while a save is in flight must discard the queued Tab advance. I’m adding a delayed-save regression and tightening that path before staging verification.


That check confirmed an existing rule: Escape is ignored while a write is in flight; cancellation remains available during preview. I’ve preserved that behavior and added a delayed-save regression to verify it still advances exactly once. No further product change was needed.


All 51 evidence files are published, including every inspected screenshot and the final 134-test result. I’m attaching the complete index to the phase and staging full verification of ledger-tools 1.140.0.


Fixed Tab save-and-advance and choice fields advancing twice. All 134 focused tests pass; 51 evidence files are published.

Full verification is staged. Deployment and phase closure remain pending the complete UI proof and startup smoke.
